chunks: Al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, peace be upon them:
"Ali, peace be upon him, held a circumciser liable who cut off the glans of a boy."

key_terms.حَشَفَةَ: the glans of the male organ
key_terms.ضَمَّنَ: he held legally liable for compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a circumciser causes serious injury to a boy during circumcision?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment from Imam 'Ali عليه السلام regarding bodily injury caused during circumcision. It establishes liability for the practitioner when harm exceeds the intended act and results in serious injury.
